items.title: Kambi to power Allwyn’s sportsbook technology consolidation in source code licensing agreement
items.summary: Kambi to power Allwyn’s sportsbook technology consolidation in source code licensing agreement 2026-11-10 12:15:00 Kambi to support the global operator in moving its sports betting brands onto a single sportsbook platform, alongside a long-term agreement for Kambi’s pricing and trading services. Together, the agreements are expected to contribute approximately €45 - 50 million to Kambi’s operating profit over 2027–2031. Kambi Group plc (“Kambi”), the world-leading provider of cutting-edge sports betting technology and services, has entered into agreements with Allwyn AG (“Allwyn”), a multi-national lottery-led gaming entertainment company.
